svg.title: Project 3 of 6: Product-Profitability. The true margin of every product of Lumo, the shop from Data-Generator, after discounts, returns, shipping, payment fees and affiliate commission, reconciled to the grosz. Each loss-making bestseller gets a reason and a move: change the price, end free delivery or delist. Methods: cost allocation, margin cascade, reconciliation, decision rules, SQL in DuckDB. Stack: Python, SQL, DuckDB, pandas, Dash, Plotly. Animated preview: its web app (Dash) at work. The bestseller slider moves from the top 500 to the top 200, the loss-making bestsellers go from 44 to 20 and their loss from -73.0k to -34.0k PLN, then a click on a product in the table opens its card with its margin cascade and order list. Link below the card: View project.
